violations.description: The banner does not use yellow (#F5C518) as the primary accent color for the headline or CTA, as required by the brand guidelines.
The "Powered by InteractiveBrokers" sub-lockup text is white, but it should be rendered in IBKR red (#D81222).
The banner includes a node network motif (el_motif_node_network), but brand rules state no motifs should be used for leaderboard format.
The "Powered by InteractiveBrokers" sub-lockup is present on the leaderboard banner, but it should not be.
The MEXEM logo (el_logo) is 456px wide, which is significantly larger than the recommended ~200px for leaderboard format.
The headline (el_headline) is entirely white, but it should have a two-color split with the first part in yellow and the rest in white.
The headline (el_headline) is in Title Case ("Access 170+ Markets Seamlessly"), but it should be in ALL CAPS.
The headline (el_headline) font size is 65px, which is smaller than the recommended ~85-95px for leaderboard format.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) font size is 14px, which is significantly smaller than the recommended ~22-26px for leaderboard format.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is placed below the CTA, but it should be positioned between the headline block and the CTA.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is center-aligned, but it should be left-aligned for the leaderboard format.
The CTA (el_cta) is a pill-shaped button positioned at y:418 and width:711, but it should be a full-width yellow band anchored to the bottom of the canvas.
The CTA (el_cta) has a transparent background, but it should have a yellow (#F5C518) background for the leaderboard format.
The CTA text ("Explore Your Options") is not in ALL CAPS, as required.
The CTA text is white, but it should be dark navy/black (#0A0F1F) for the leaderboard format's yellow band.
The CTA (el_cta) has rounded corners (pill shape), but it should have sharp corners (border-radius: 0) for the full-width bottom band.
The CTA (el_cta) text is missing the required chevron ('>') after the text.
The leaderboard banner is missing the required device mockup in the visual region on the right side of the canvas.
The headline (el_headline) is positioned at x:245, but it should be at x:50 for the leaderboard format.
The banner includes a vertical line pattern (el_brand_pattern), but brand rules state no patterns should be used for leaderboard format.
The eyebrow text 'HIGH-VOLTAGE TRADING' uses red (#D81222) as a general accent color, which is reserved for the 'Powered by InteractiveBrokers' lockup only.
The background is a solid color (#00122C) instead of a linear gradient from #00122C to #006A97.
A node network motif is present, but decorative motifs are explicitly disallowed for this style.
For a square format, the logo should be centered horizontally at the top, not top-left.
The headline 'Access 170+ Markets Seamlessly' is entirely white, but it must have a two-color split (yellow for the key claim, white for the rest).
The headline 'Access 170+ Markets Seamlessly' is in Title Case, but it must be in ALL CAPS.
The subheadline 'Efficiently harness global market opportunities.' is in Sentence Case, but it must be in ALL CAPS.
The disclaimer is placed below the CTA, but it must be between the headline block and the CTA.
The CTA background is transparent, but it should be white for a pill-shaped CTA.
The CTA text 'Explore Your Options →' is not in ALL CAPS.
The CTA text color is white, but it should be dark navy/black (#0A0F1F) for a white pill CTA.
The CTA is left-aligned, but it should be horizontally centered for a pill-shaped CTA.
The pill-shaped CTA includes a chevron (arrow), but the rule for portrait (and by extension, square) states 'No chevron'.
A vertical line pattern is present, but decorative patterns are explicitly disallowed for this style.
The CTA background is transparent (white outline), but should be yellow (#F5C518) for a leaderboard.
The CTA text color is white (#FFFFFF), but should be dark navy/black (#0A0F1F).
A decorative motif (el_motif_abstract_bars) is present at the bottom of the banner, but the brand rules state no motifs should be used.
The background (el_background) is a solid navy color, but should be a linear gradient from #00122C to #006A97.
The 'Powered by InteractiveBrokers' sub-lockup is present below the el_logo, but should not be on a leaderboard format.
The el_logo size (456px wide) is too large for a leaderboard, which should be around 200px wide.
The el_headline 'Discover The Unseen Edge' is entirely white, but should have a two-color split (first part yellow, rest white).
The el_headline 'Discover The Unseen Edge' is in title case, but should be ALL CAPS.
The el_headline font size (39px) is too small for a leaderboard, which should be around 85-95px.
The el_disclaimer font size (14px) is too small for a leaderboard, which should be around 22-26px.
The el_disclaimer is placed below the CTA, but should be between the headline block and the CTA.
The el_disclaimer is center-aligned, but should be left-aligned for a leaderboard.
The el_cta is a pill-shaped button, but should be a full-width yellow band anchored to the bottom edge of the canvas for a leaderboard.
The el_cta text 'Explore Your Edge →' is not ALL CAPS.
The el_cta has rounded corners (pill shape), but should have sharp corners (0 border-radius) for a leaderboard bottom band.
The banner does not use yellow as the primary accent color anywhere, which is a hard rule for accent color usage outside the IBKR lockup.
The 'el_motif_abstract_bars' is a prominent decorative motif, violating the 'No motif' rule for clean references.
The 'el_motif_abstract_bars' is not the subtle ghost candlestick pattern mentioned as an exception for portrait format, and it is not subtle.
For the square format, the MEXEM logo (el_logo) is placed top-left instead of top-center.
The headline (el_headline) is entirely white, violating the rule that it must be split into a yellow 'key claim' and a white supporting clause.
The headline (el_headline) 'Discover The Unseen Edge' is in Title Case, not ALL CAPS as required.

The CTA (el_cta) has a transparent background, but should have a white background for a pill CTA style.
